title: Decision of the 107th Meeting of the Committee Responsible for Initial Determinations regarding the creation of a Joint Venture, Mawezi RDC S.A., by Airtel RDC S.A., and Orange RDC S.A.
lineage: Original publication on the issuing organisation’s website.

passages.locator: Overview of the 2Africa West Cable System, paragraphs 18–20
passages.note: The Commission describes SDM1 supplied by Alcatel Submarine Networks and the design ceiling of 16 fibre pairs. The decision describes the project design, not its final route-by-route commissioning. Its underlying transaction description draws in part on submissions by the parties.
